selection.basis: es-419 has 87 identical-source entries and 1115 low-confidence records, the highest identical-source count among low-confidence drafts; this is a triage signal, not a quality score.
selection.scope: Spanish regional variants; bounded battery calculator review, not a complete locale critique.
selection.activeCycles: Neither selected locale has an active cycle; queue states remain unchanged.

scope.excluded: Other calculators, shared validation resources, battery manager/catalog dictionaries and whole-locale review are outside the linguistic audit.

signatures.algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify([semanticId, text]); no aggregate signatures
signatures.ordering: Semantic IDs sorted by helper; targets ordered es, es-419

evidence: Canonical English calculators.batt entries included per row
src/pages/batt/battery-drain-calculator.tsx: per-cell fields, configuration summary, matched-cell notice and pack output consumers
the Steam Engine Kirchhoff's laws reference: series current and parallel branches
Existing Spanish locale glossaries: battery consumption and output power

counts.renderedOccurrenceCount: Not counted; shared calculator labels can occur more than once.

unresolvedQuestions: Competent human linguistic review remains pending; machine corrections do not certify whole-locale quality.

checks: 56 focused tests in translation-review, calculator-messages and battery API/domain/component suites
npm run build (host identity): full production build; 39 IIS rules, 64 route cases; 737 links across 10279 HTML files; verified IIS slot switch

verified: Correct HTML language and page title
Localized per-cell introduction, preset and configuration labels
Custom configuration exposes Celdas en serie and Ramas en paralelo in es
Localized matched-cell warning in both variants
No document horizontal overflow; es-419 full-page screenshot inspected
limitations: Live calculation request failed with Failed to fetch; result cards and their runtime help could not be inspected in the browser. API/domain/component tests passed.
Blank capacity interaction produced no inline error while the calculation failure dialog was active; validation rendering is not claimed.

entries.sourceText: This idealized estimate assumes continuous output at the calculated battery power. Real runtime varies with cutoff voltage, voltage sag, cell age, device overhead, and intermittent use.

es.after: Esta estimación idealizada supone que la batería entrega continuamente la potencia calculada. La autonomía real varía según el voltaje de corte, la caída de voltaje, la antigüedad de la celda, el consumo del propio dispositivo y el uso intermitente.
es.rationale: Device overhead is the device’s own energy consumption, not overload; runtime means operating duration.
